# Quiz Maker

> > Quiz Maker is an AI-powered online quiz creation platform with auto-grading, lead capture, and analytics, serving educational, entertainment, and training needs globally since 2004.

Based in Australia and operating since 2004, Quiz Maker enables users to create quizzes ranging from personality tests and educational assessments to training materials and trivia. The platform supports multiple languages and includes features like automatic grading, customizable templates, and lead generation tools.

## Key Topics

- QuizMaker platform
- AI quiz generator
- Auto-grading
- Lead capture
- Personality tests
- Educational assessments
- Training quizzes
- Quiz analytics
- Multi-language support
- Customer service training
- Mental health assessment (MHC-SF)
- Trivia quizzes
- Survey forms
- Quiz templates

## Getting Started

- [Quiz Maker | Make Free Online Quizzes in Seconds](https://quiz-maker.com): Quiz Maker homepage: AI quiz generator with auto-grading and lead capture
- [About Us - Learn About the Buzz at Quiz Maker](https://quiz-maker.com/About): Quiz Maker company history, mission, and team info since 2004 in Australia
- [Creating your Quiz: Quiz Help](https://quiz-maker.com/Quiz-Help): Quiz Maker help documentation for creating, managing, and analyzing quizzes
- [Contact Quiz Maker - Get in Touch](https://quiz-maker.com/Contact): Quiz Maker contact form for support, bugs, refunds, and account help
